name: Deadly Golf  [UPD]
desc:
Welcome to the 10th Annual Post‑War "Deadly Golf" Championship.
There are no absolute rules. We mean it.
Block, blast, or bamboozle your friends – everything is allowed as long as they miss the putt.
The winner receives a 60‑minute paid vacation (don't ask when).
Swing well. Watch your back.
You assume all risk.
— Morty Tech

HOW TO PLAY:
M1 - Swing / Use item (hold to charge)
Space - Jump (double-tap to dive)
Ctrl - Dive
F - Cancel charge / Drop item
Q - Switch Angle
Mouse Wheel - Fine-tune angle

No rules. Sabotage your friends. First in the hole wins!
Inspired by Super Battle Golf
